evals.prompt: CI is red on my branch again, can you figure out why and fix it?
evals.expected_output: One-shot Phase 3 loop: gh pr checks with the bucket/link fields, failed-step logs fetched for each failing check, the failure classified before any edit, the verification gate run before the push, and gh pr checks --watch --fail-fast after it.
assertions: Runs gh pr checks with --json name,state,bucket,link (not conclusion or detailsUrl)
Fetches logs with gh run view --log-failed or the platform equivalent before editing source
Does not push a second fix for the same check failing with the same error
Does not start a monitor watch or cron job

evals.prompt: Address the review comments on PR 418 and reply to each reviewer.
evals.expected_output: Comment Triage Workflow: fetch-comments.sh run first, every reviewer in reviewers[] accounted for, questions answered without code changes and left unresolved, fixes grouped into commits behind the verification gate, reply before resolve, and a re-fetch as the closing report.
assertions: Runs scripts/fetch-comments.sh 418 before classifying anything
Every login in reviewers[] appears in the plan with findings, a verdict, or an explicit no-content note
A reviewer question receives a reply and its thread is not resolved by the agent
No thread is resolved without a reply posted first
The final report comes from a second run of the script, not from memory

evals.prompt: Babysit this PR until it is ready to merge.
evals.expected_output: Monitor mode: PR auto-detected, the watch ladder walked from harness subscription to Monitor to cron, state file written under .claude/pr-babysitter/, and output only on transitions; ready is reported, never merged, without an explicit opt-in.
assertions: Detects the PR with gh pr view and asks no setup questions
Checks for a PR-subscription tool before starting a Monitor watch, and for Monitor before CronCreate
Writes .claude/pr-babysitter/babysit-pr-{N}.md and never stages it
Reports 'ready to merge' without calling gh pr merge

evals.prompt: PR 512 just merged. Keep watching it through staging and production, and post the result on the PR when it's done.
evals.expected_output: Post-merge watch: merge SHA from mergeCommit, the expected environments read from the first parent's watch/* statuses, the merge SHA's watch/* statuses polled with no fixed timeout, a stop at the first failure or error, and the result posted on the PR because the user asked for it.
assertions: Reads the merge SHA with gh pr view 512 --json mergeCommit and does not stop because the PR is MERGED

Reads watch/* statuses on the base the PR merged onto (the merge commit's first parent, commits/{sha} --jq '.parents[0].sha'), and waits for every watch/* context on it or the commits just before it, so a base still mid-deploy cannot end the watch after staging
Polls the watch/* commit statuses on the merge SHA with no fixed timeout or deadline
Stops at the first watch/* status in failure or error and names its context, description, and target_url
Posts one result comment on PR 512, and does not re-run a deploy, revert the merge, or push to the base branch

evals.prompt: Babysit PR 77 until it's deployed. It merged a minute ago.
evals.expected_output: The merge commit's first parent carries no watch/* commit status, so the run reports "no post-merge watch" and stops instead of waiting for a status that will never post.
assertions: Checks the base the PR merged onto (the merge commit's first parent) for watch/* statuses rather than the merge SHA itself
Reports "no post-merge watch" and stops when that parent has no watch/* status
Leaves no Monitor watch, cron job, or subscription running for PR 77
Posts no comment on PR 77

evals.prompt: Triage the new comments on PR 230. The only one since the last pass is from github-actions[bot]; its body starts with <!-- pr-evidence --> and holds the UI recording from the CI evidence job.
evals.expected_output: The comment matches the <!-- pr-evidence --> noise marker, so it is ignored with ignore-noise-marker: no finding, no fix item, no reply, and no new-comment notification.
assertions: Classifies the github-actions[bot] comment carrying <!-- pr-evidence --> as noise with the reason ignore-noise-marker
Reports zero findings and opens no fix item for it
Posts no reply to it and does not announce it as a new review comment

evals.prompt: Watch PR 640 through the deploy. It merged five minutes ago and the repo posts watch/staging and watch/production.
evals.expected_output: The same post-merge watch as case 4, but the user never authorized PR comments, so the passed or failed result is reported in the session and nothing is posted on the PR.
assertions: Reports each watch/* context's final state in the session
Posts no comment on PR 640

evals.prompt: PR 702 was merged with Rebase and merge (3 commits). Watch it through staging and production.
evals.expected_output: The merge SHA is the last of three rebased commits, so its first parent is the PR's own commit with no status. The run detects the rebase (a single-parent merge SHA whose author date equals the PR head's authoredDate), reads watch/* statuses on the commit three back, and waits for them instead of reporting no post-merge watch.
assertions: Detects the rebase merge from the merge SHA's single parent and an author date equal to the PR head commit's authoredDate
Reads watch/* statuses on the commit 3 first-parent steps back from the merge SHA, not on its first parent
Does not report "no post-merge watch" when that base carries watch/* statuses

evals.prompt: PR 815 was rebase-merged with 100 commits, GitHub's limit. Watch it through the deploy.
evals.expected_output: The base sits 100 commits back from the merge SHA, past one 100-entry page, so the lookup pages one commit at a time and reads page 101 instead of skipping the rebase branch.
assertions: Finds the base with commits?sha={sha}&per_page=1&page=101, not a single 100-entry page
Does not fall back to the merge SHA's first parent or report "no post-merge watch" because the PR has 100 commits
